# RunLedger
> A tamper-evident flight recorder for AI agent runs.

RunLedger records tool calls, retries, decisions, outputs, and evidence in hash-chained JSONL.
It verifies tampering and renders a local HTML execution report.

Repository: https://github.com/yashkhou/runledger
Docs: https://yashkhou.github.io/runledger/
License: MIT
Canonical technical source: the GitHub README and source code.
